propositions: Copilot CLI silently drops three rebar skills (rebar-implement, rebar-janitor, rebar-debug) due to YAML frontmatter violations: over-capacity descriptions and unquoted colons.
The Agent Skills spec enforces a 1024-character limit on the description field and strict YAML parsing, but provides no error feedback when skills fail to register.

Three failing skills have specific YAML frontmatter issues: rebar-implement and rebar-janitor exceed 1024 characters; rebar-debug contains an unquoted colon in a plain scalar that breaks YAML parsing.
A new deterministic CI lint check (check_skill_frontmatter.py) must be added to catch frontmatter violations at commit/CI time before skills silently fail to load in Copilot.
All four SKILL.md files must be fixed to use YAML folded block scalars for descriptions and trimmed to ≤1024 characters while preserving each skill's /rebar-<name> invocation trigger.
The lint check must verify frontmatter YAML validity, description presence/non-emptiness/length, and name format compliance (≤64 chars, matching ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$).
